MATCH (o:Owner)-[r:Owns]->(t:Team)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
WITH DISTINCT o, r,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE date_part('year', DATE('2026-10-15')) - date_part('year', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) -
      CASE
        WHEN date_part('month', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) > 10
          OR (date_part('month', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) = 10 AND date_part('day', strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')) > 15)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
  END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age <= 76
   OR o.name = 'Joseph Chung-Hsin Tsai'
   OR CAST(r.since_year AS INT64) > 2013
   OR o.nationality = 'American'
RETURN r.since_year AS col1, owner_age AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
